entities.summary: Takao Shrine  was a Shinto shrine located in the former Takao City, Takao Prefecture, Taiwan during the Japanese rule period. The shrine enshrined Prince Yoshihisa, Ōmononushi no Mikoto (大物主命), and Emperor Sutoku.
